name: AeroPlayer
changelog:
• Flawless A/V Lip-Sync on Seek & Reverse: Synchronized audio/video stream boundaries with -noaccurate_seek on remux copy and dynamic hardware sample rate locking (aresample=async=1); completely eliminates audio lag after rewinding or seeking across MKV/EAC3 web series (e.g. Ozark)
• Standard Player Controls Parity: Mapped J to 10s Rewind/Reverse, K to Play/Pause toggle, L to 10s Fast-Forward; moved fine-tuning audio delay to Shift+J / Shift+K to prevent accidental desync
• Clean Audio Sync Reset: Resetting audio delay to 0ms now automatically purges corrupted per-media delay offsets from local storage
• Smart Empty Audio Track Detection: Clearly displays 'No audio tracks in file' when loading video-only files
• Bare Minimum CPU & GPU: Full VA-API hardware pipeline (<3% CPU on 10-bit HEVC, <0.5% CPU on MKV remux, 0% GPU load when idle)
